commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) takes a short corner kick.
90+8' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Real Madrid get a corner.
90+6' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) works the corner short.

90+5' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Real Madrid.

90+3' 1 - 0 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a magnificent shot into the top left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Unai Simon, so the score changes to 1:0.
90+2' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
90+2' A quickly taken corner by Real Madrid.

90+1' What a wonderful moment! Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) receives a perfect pass in the middle of the pitch, lines up the ball and unloads a powerful strike towards the bottom left corner. His effort fails to surprise Unai Simon, who makes a nice save. Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.

90' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao. Close! Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) is a whisker away from finishing-off the move he started. His close-range effort flies just over the bar.
87' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
87' Here comes a substitution. Adama Boiro is given a rest as he is replaced by Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao).
86' Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
86' Unai Simon leaps to intercept the corner kick from Arda Guler (Real Madrid).

86' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. Now Real Madrid have a corner.
85' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
85' Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. It's a free kick to Real Madrid in a dangerous position.

79' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) makes himself some space on the edge of the penalty area and pulls the trigger. His accurate effort goes off the post into the bottom left corner and the score changes to 1:0.

78' Substitution. Arda Guler (Real Madrid) has come on for Luka Modric.

76' A cross by Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
75' A yellow card for a tackle by Raul Asencio (Real Madrid). Juan Martinez doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
72' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Unai Gomez walks off the pitch to be replaced by Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao).

71' Endrick (Real Madrid) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team. Ath Bilbao have a free kick.
71' Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) commits a foul and Juan Martinez immediately signals a free kick. Real Madrid are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
69' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the roof of the net lacks power and Unai Simon easily makes the save.

67' OFF THE POST! Good play from Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) as skips past two defending players and from the edge of the box unleashes a decent strike that smashes the right post! The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
66' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
64' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid).
63' Juan Martinez rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Unai Nunez (Ath Bilbao).
63' Unai Nunez (Ath Bilbao) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. A free kick to Real Madrid.
62' A substitution has been made. Gorka Guruzeta goes off and Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) comes on.
62' Ernesto Valverde has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) replacing Alvaro Djalo.
62' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Alex Berenguer.

61' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

61' A brilliant cross into the box finds Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid), who directs his header towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes an astonishing save. Real Madrid win a corner.
60' The ball is laid off to Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the bottom right corner and forces Thibaut Courtois to make a decent save.
59' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) tries to find Endrick, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
58' Here's the change. Dani Ceballos leaves the pitch and Endrick (Real Madrid) comes on as a substitute.

57' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Juan Martinez blows for a foul. Ath Bilbao get a free kick.
56' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.

54' Luka Modric has a look up and finds Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) in space. He wastes no time in trying to test the keeper from distance but the shot is just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
53' Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
53' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes it short.
52' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

52' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The ball goes out for a corner. Real Madrid can continue in their attacking effort.
51' Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.

50' A pass from Luka Modric (Real Madrid) is intercepted by Unai Simon and the move breaks down.
49' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

49' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the left post is thwarted by Unai Simon. Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.

48' A rebound falls to Rodrygo (Real Madrid) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.

39' Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

28' The opposition back off Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) and he lashes in a shot from the edge of the box that just flies over the bar. Unlucky! The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.

23' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Real Madrid will take a throw-in.
21' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. There is a free kick near the sideline to Real Madrid.

20' Poor challenge! Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for tripping and Juan Martinez blows his whistle. Real Madrid win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
18' Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.

16' The most active player in today's match is definitely Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid). He's trying to be on the ball as much as possible and you can literally see the enthusiasm in his play. He keeps exchanging some one touch passes and waits for the right moment to send a killer pass. What a player!
13' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
9' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) swings in a cross from the corner, but Unai Simon reads it well and gathers the ball.
9' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Real Madrid have a corner.
